connector.name: Scout by Flikah
connector.registryDescription: Find licensed real estate agents, search MLS, route leads. Remote MCP for SC + GA brokerages.
connector.summary: Hosted at scout.realestate over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the flikah account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token for authenticated tools (scout.route_lead, scout.get_seller_signals). Anonymous access works without this header for scout.coverage, scout.search_listings, and scout.find_agent. Request a key at spencer@flikah.com.
